subject: Re: Kickoff: DePlot chart QA for the analytics suite
body:
Status: fine-tuning from the released DePlot checkpoint is working end to end on Cirrus. On our internal dashboard eval, plot-to-table exact structure match is at 71%, and downstream QA accuracy is 64% when we chain the table into the reasoning model.

The main risk is derendering quality on our densest chart types. DePlot's strength is standard bar/line/pie; our stacked area charts with more than 8 series lose rows in the linearized table, and every dropped row is an unrecoverable QA error downstream. MatCha-style pretraining on chart derendering would likely help, but that is real pretraining compute, not fine-tuning.

Proposal: keep fine-tuning only, and scope stacked-area out of the June demo. Will bring numbers to the next review.

Maren
